name: open-code-review
description: Secure, fast, efficient, battle-tested at Alibaba's scale. Hybrid architecture code review tool: deterministic pipelines + LLM Agent, precise line-level comments, built-in multi-language ruleset (NPE, thread-safety, XSS, SQL injection), OpenAI & Anthropic compatible.
one_liner: An AI reviewer that reads every code change on a team and leaves precise comments about bugs and security holes, like a tireless senior engineer who checks every pull request.
buyer: An engineering director at a mid-size company (50-500 engineers) who wants more consistent code review without hiring more senior reviewers, and is wary of noisy generic AI review bots.
business_use_cases: A fast-growing startup wires it into GitHub so every pull request gets security and bug comments before a human even looks, catching issues junior devs miss.
An outsourcing dev shop uses it to enforce a consistent quality bar across many client codebases without hiring a reviewer for each one.
A fintech company's compliance team uses its ruleset (SQL injection, XSS checks) as a documented, auditable gate before code ships.

money_ideas.idea: Offer a hosted SaaS version with dashboards, team analytics, and support so companies don't have to self-host
Sell custom rulesets for regulated industries (healthcare, finance) as a paid add-on
Charge per-review usage pricing for large organizations running thousands of PRs a month

steal_this: Stand up a hosted, zero-config 'install our GitHub App and get AI code review in 2 minutes' service this weekend, charging small dev teams a flat monthly fee — the self-host-only friction of the open source repo is the opening.
